capabilities: Sync a vault with a Git branch
Transfer commits and files in small batches
Merge text changes line by line
Revert changed files to the last sync
disambiguation: Not a general Git client; it only syncs a vault with one branch of a Git repository.
extras: Try it on a copy of a vault first; it has not run on a real phone or iOS; requires Git protocol v2 and SHA-1; Git LFS files arrive as pointer files.
motivation: Built to sync a vault with a Git repository on a phone without a Git program or holding more than a few megabytes at a time.
problem: Syncing an Obsidian vault with a Git repository on a phone is hard because mobile devices lack a Git program and cannot hold large repository data in memory.

relations.evidence: For a repository on github.com it also asks api.github.com for the sizes of the files
GitLab and Codeberg do not answer when git asks for sizes
GitLab and Codeberg do not answer when git asks for sizes

summary: Git-based vault sync that transfers commits and files in small batches, designed to work on phones without a Git program.
